description: Add a domain you control. Returns the DNS records to publish: a TXT record that proves ownership and the MX record(s). Publish every record with required=true, then call verify_domain. The setup flow: signup (once) -> add_domain -> publish the returned DNS records at the domain's DNS host -> verify_domain -> set_alias. Mail is forwarded only to destinations confirmed through the link mailed to them.
name: add_domain
title: Add a domain
